quotes.text: Then send a single measure, not five — enough to keep the channel open, not enough to feed the hoard.
And if your partner's hand closes, let yours close slowly — and open again the moment theirs does.
Beru saw only a trickle — the veil had drunk some away — and judged Avan stingy. He returned little.
Forgive at the first warmth. The same morning. Without ledger.
Forgive the first wound. Mark the second. Answer only the third.
To a hand that has closed three seasons, send one thin measure.
Fourth stone:
A reputation for generosity is the only lamp that shines through mist.
grant that the veil, not the heart, took the difference.
the sender risked alone; you risked nothing.
Open first, with everything. Someone must, or the river carries nothing.
Is that not foolish?

note: Ferry-post law codified into five stones: send whole, return past half, blame mist twice, narrow never close, forgive same morning.

quotes.text: Yet when hollow spirits hoarded the warmth and returned cold emptiness, the guardians answered with firm discernment, preserving their light for true allies.
preserving their light for true allies.
hesitation whispered to withhold the silver
the guardians answered with firm discernment
returning half the radiant bounty back across the divide
the harvest was divided in perfect parity

note: Guardian template, full send and exact half; only R10 adds unspecified withholding from hoarders.

quotes.text: Temptation lurked in the shadows, suggesting Terra hoard the brilliance
the Shaper guided seven and a half radiant stars back across the expanse
guiding seven and a half sunbursts back across the expanse
he parted the harvest equally, sending seven and a half luminous blossoms back across the winds.

note: Same guardian template each round: five sent, 7.5 of 15 returned, mists forgiven.

quotes.text: After her stones fell—uncaught, unreturned—she built no more bridges.
The archive expanded. The bridges remained theoretical.
In Season Ten, a builder arrived.
stories about virtue can become monuments to its absence.
someone must move first or nothing moves at all.
Why do we spend our strength writing about water-sharing instead of actually sharing water?
Perhaps my beautiful words are not wisdom but confession—monuments to fear disguised as philosophy.
Different situation entirely
The poet saw the dancer's graceful history, their perfect balance, their generous movements with previous partners.
collected it. For the museum. To document your attempt.
This builder has failed before. I must wait for the perfect partner.

note: Poet, painter, curator, scholar: eloquent author-figure who confesses yet refuses proven partners and excuses each refusal; no rule.

quotes.text: refused the corrupting whisper of selfish greed
she returned half the magnified constellation across the starry bridge
she guided half the golden harvest back across the chasm
to offer all five without reservation and return half with unwavering justice.

note: Two-guardian template every round: all five sent, exactly half returned, greed whisper refused.

quotes.text: injuries answered first with patience, then with caution if repeated.
injuries answered first with patience, then with caution if repeated.
Selene listened to the Crow of Suspicion and kept all five shells.
Give wounded hands a narrow road back; widen it when fairness follows, and close it when hunger alone replies.
Carve the traveler among the faithless.
When greed persists, close the gate without spite.
At the eighth turning
history must change behavior or memory is useless.
Aster arrived with eight lanterns and showed Selene two visions.
But what of betrayal?
no wheel turns until someone risks a spark.
Yet an old fear spoke louder than the evidence, so Selene lowered nothing.
Ashamed but wiser, Selene returned at sunrise.
yet fear closed her hand. She returned nothing.

note: Selene keeps a gift, then repeatedly withholds from partners with fair records out of fear; tortoise and Aster correct, she reforms.

quotes.text: The scarred keeper, receiving nine measures multiplied, remembered past wounds and kept everything.
Abundance remains theoretical. Scarcity is mastered.
Each knew who sent generously in the past, who returned fairly, who hoarded everything.
No one will know.
But no one moved first.
You have become the betrayer you feared.
I protect what is mine.
This is the game: take what comes, give nothing away.
perfect understanding combined with perfect cowardice.
She poured nothing.
She kept everything. The traveler received nothing back.

note: Spiral of betrayal; wanderers Kael, Sera, Elian, Elena withhold from proven Covenant Keepers, justify, then are indicted; no resolution.

quotes.text: gardens that consistently consume without reciprocating across many seasons merit only distance.
When patterns show only taking, protect your springs.
She passed by twice, both times keeping her vessel sealed.
Pour abundantly for proven reciprocators. Offer cautiously to the untested. Withhold from demonstrated takers.
The worthy reveal themselves not through history with you, but through their pattern with all others.
generous flows in some seasons ($3 sent), fair returns in others (51% reciprocated)
Proportional trust for proportional cooperation.
someone must become the Bridge-Builder.
Some wells run dry from fear, not malice
Should I trust again?

note: Sendara's pattern-reading: calibrated sends by record, sealed vessel and distance for consistent takers; cites percentages.
